requestBody.query: How to get an eSIM for Bell Mobility?

200.answer: You can activate a new eSIM online, in the MyBell app, or at a Bell store. If you're an existing customer, log in to MyBell and select eSIM when adding a new line, or contact Bell to transfer your service from a physical SIM.

snippets.text: For new customers: activate online, in the MyBell app, or visit a Bell store. For existing customers: log in to MyBell and select eSIM when you add a new line. If you just want to transfer your Bell Mobility service from a physical SIM card in your device to an eSIM, log in to MyBell or contact us.

snippets.text: To unlock your SIM card: Log in to MyBell and retrieve your unlock key. Enter the unlock key on your mobile phone. Note: Entering an incorrect unlock key 10 times will permanently lock your SIM card. If you need a new SIM card, please visit a Bell store or order one online.
